::: {#def-brnffrcistg .theorem}
## BRNFFRCISTG model

A bipartite random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (BRNFFRCISTG) is a causal model $\mathcal{C}=(\mathcal{M},\mathcal{M}^{(\Gamma)})$ of a BRNNPSEM $\mathcal{M}$ that satisfies the conditions of an RNFFRCISTG, except that single-world independence takes each $\boldsymbol{\Psi}_{ti}$, rather than each graph generator, as a single variable.
:::
